notes: No more periods after every sentence, in every message. Inside spoken lines, sentences now run on with commas the way people actually talk: "Hey. Come in. Nangong said you were coming." becomes "Hey, come in, Nangong said you were coming". Only the very last spoken line of a reply keeps a period, because that's the conversation ending. Names and "I" stay capitalized, and "...", ! and ? are left alone. Texts work the same way. Stories and texts you already have are cleaned up once when you open them.
